From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@retailco.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation asset handoff and MAP proposal

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. RetailCo is ready to move forward with a short evaluation: we need to get a small prompt pack + 10k testcases into our sandbox to validate checkout flows and recommendations. Before we ingest anything, legal has asked for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that spells out: delivery milestones, limited-use licensing for evaluation only, retention/takedown windows, and an audit window.

High level ask: can Redwood provision the assets with the following constraints?
- Assets available to RetailCo engineers only (2 named accounts + ephemeral sandbox tokens)
- Evaluation period: 30 days from handoff
- No derivative commercial use; results used only for internal evaluation
- Redwood retains the right to request deletion after audit window (7 days post-eval)

We'd like a first-draft MAP and a manifest of files by EOD Apr 9 so our security team can start clearance. Attaching a short list of the data slices we want (see referenced manifest).

Thanks,
Ellie Ramos
Head of Data Science, RetailCo

Subject: Re: Evaluation asset handoff and MAP proposal

Ellie —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We can do this. Summary of what Redwood will provide and next steps:

1) Deliverables (target EOD Apr 9):
   - Draft MAP (covers milestones, roles, access model, usage constraints) — attachment: MAP_RetailCo_v1.pdf
   - Prompt pack (redacted sample set) and manifest — attachment: testcase_manifest_20270407.csv

2) Access model:
   - Two named engineer accounts + sandbox tokens tied to your VPC egress list.
   - Ephemeral tokens expire at end of 30-day eval window; token revocation URL will be included in MAP.

3) Usage & retention:
   - Evaluation-only license; no commercial derivatives; we propose a 45-day audit window after the 30-day evaluation (total preservation window = 75 days) to allow replay for troubleshooting. If RetailCo prefers 7-day post-eval retention, highlight it and we can update the MAP.

4) Security & compliance hooks:
   - We will provide SOC-2 artifacts and a short attestation for the delivery.

Next steps:
- Kimberly (cc) will circulate a short legal redline by Apr 12.
- Grace will own the actual provisioning and will propose a handoff slot (we can do Apr 21 or Apr 22).

Attachments: MAP_RetailCo_v1.pdf (draft), testcase_manifest_20270407.csv

If that looks good I will push the prompt pack to the Drive folder and send the provisioning calendar invite.

—Marcus

Marcus —

Thanks — early note that our PM (Devon) will track the runbook. A couple quick clarifications from our side before legal redlines:
- Can Redwood tag promptpack items with an asset id and a checksum so we can map generated outputs back to source testcases?
- RetailCo would prefer the shorter retention (7 days post-eval) if there are no blocking support needs. Could you list exceptions (e.g., active bug investigations) that would allow extended retention?

Also, please share links to the HubSpot deal and the Drive folder for our procurement and security teams — that makes the intake faster.

HubSpot note: https://hubspot.retailco.com/deal/undefined (we'll paste our internal record once we sync)

Subject: Redwood legal — MAP redline and notes

Ellie / Marcus / Grace —

Attached is a redline of the MAP (summary below). I focused on preserving the evaluation-only covenant while keeping the handoff timeline intact. Attachments referenced: MAP_RetailCo_v1_redline.pdf, summary_redline_notes.txt

Redline highlights:
- Limited-use clause: explicit prohibition on commercializing trained models or derivative datasets from the prompt pack/testcases; allowed use = internal evaluation and model tuning for this pilot only.
- Retention: we accept RetailCo's request for a 7-day post-eval retention window, with a carve-out allowing retention only if both parties agree in writing for active investigations; otherwise expiry is automatic.
- Audit & access: Redwood may request a one-time access log dump within 7 days of any suspected misuse; RetailCo can request an audit copy for debugging (mutually agreed scope).
- Escrow/escrow-like hold: we propose a short-term escrow of anonymized sample indices if either party requests preservation for compliance.

One operational question for Grace: can you confirm that named accounts + temporary tokens will be enforceable via the sandbox ACL and that token revocation is operationally testable before handoff?

If the above is acceptable I'll send the redline PDF and proposed final MAP for signature.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_RetailCo_v1_redline.pdf, summary_redline_notes.txt

Kimberly / Marcus —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the level of detail. RetailCo Legal has reviewed your redline. We're comfortable with the limited-use language and the 7-day retention as drafted, with one small ask: can we shift the final handoff window to Apr 23 (one day later) to allow our infra team to complete whitelisting and run the ingress test?

Also request: please include the checksum-and-asset-id tagging that Ellie requested in the manifest and confirm that the ephemeral tokens can be rotated without requiring code changes on our side. If you can confirm both items in writing we are ready to sign the MAP and proceed with the prompt pack handoff.

Suggested next steps:
- Redwood sends final MAP for signature (DocuSign link preferred)
- Provisioning calendar invite for Apr 23 (Grace to propose times)
- Redwood to upload promptpack zip and manifest to the Drive link and confirm checksums in the manifest

We will sign once the above is confirmed.

Best,
RetailCo Legal
